entities.name: Carmela Arias y Díaz de Rábago
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carmela Arias y Díaz de Rábago was a Spanish banker who, in 1971, became the first woman president of a bank in Spain, a post she held for 30 years. She also became known as Countess of Fenosa.
